data.description: Object requires preservation assessment by a collections care specialist. First step in preservation need determination.
Object needs examination by a professional conservator.
The current storage housing for the object is inadequate. Needs new housing (box, folder, matting, framing, etc.) or improvements to the current housing.
Object needs to be removed from its current mat and/or frame.
Object needs minor cleaning such as dusting or vacuuming.
Requires a change of preservative solution.
Replace existing mount and mounting medium; for example, microscope slides.
